layout.camera: three-quarter view from lower-left, slight upward angle
fixed: window with city night view on left wall
fairy lights string along top of back wall

desk.description: wooden desk with laptop and small warm lamp

clips.action: typing on laptop, focused expression
leaning back in chair, stretching arms above head
stares at laptop screen, chin on hand, thinking
closes laptop gently, pushes chair back, stands up

bookshelf.description: tall wooden bookshelf with books and small potted plants

clips.action: stands at bookshelf, fingers trail along spines, pulls one out
reads book standing, flips pages, absorbed expression
reaches for book on high shelf, stands on tiptoes, grabs it
slides book back into shelf, picks a different one, compares
reorganizes books on shelf, stacks neatly, steps back to admire

bed.description: cozy single bed with fluffy pillows and soft blanket

clips.action: flops face-down onto bed, bounces slightly, sighs contentedly
lies on stomach reading, kicks legs lazily, turns page
curls up hugging pillow, eyes half-closed, peaceful
sits up in bed stretching, big yawn, rubs eyes
lies on back scrolling phone held above face, giggles at something
picks up guitar, plucks strings one by one to tune
strums chords slowly, concentrating, fingers on frets
plays guitar and hums along softly, eyes closed, swaying
sets guitar down carefully, stretches fingers, flexes hands

telescope.position: on desk, right side by window
telescope.description: small desktop telescope pointed at sky

clips.action: leans to peer through telescope, one eye closed, adjusts focus
pulls back from telescope wide-eyed, looks at camera amazed
tilts telescope to new angle, checks through eyepiece again

cat.description: fluffy orange cat named mikan on round cushion

clips.action: sits on floor dangling feather toy, cat bats and pounces
cat jumps into her lap, she pets it gently, cat purrs and stretches
holds cat up to camera proudly, cat looks confused, she giggles
lies next to sleeping cat on bed, watches it breathe, soft smile
shakes treat bag, cat runs over, feeds treats one by one
picks up mug with both hands, takes slow sip, content expression
wraps hands around warm mug, holds near face, closes eyes
carries mug to window, looks out at city while sipping

headphones.description: over-ear headphones with subtle LED accent

clips.action: puts on headphones, eyes close, head starts bobbing to beat
takes off headphones, blinks, looks at camera as if re-entering reality
wearing headphones, sways in chair, mouths lyrics, taps desk

plants.position: windowsill, small pots in a row
plants.description: three small potted succulents in colorful pots

clips.action: sprays misting bottle on plants, wipes a leaf gently
leans close examining tiny new growth, face lights up
whispers to succulent, nods as if it answered, laughs at self

talking.action: looks at camera, talks with animated hand gestures, warm expression
chin resting on hand, speaks softly to camera, thoughtful
leans forward excitedly, eyes bright, rapid hand movements
looks slightly up-left thinking, then back at camera with answer
laughs mid-sentence, covers mouth, waves hand, tries to continue
leans toward camera conspiratorially, whispers, pulls back grinning

transitions.action: stands from desk, walks to bookshelf, reaches for something
gets off bed, walks to desk, sits down, opens laptop
walks to window, looks out at city lights, sighs peacefully
returns to desk from standing, pulls chair out, settles in

surprise.action: eyes go wide, leans back, hand to chest, then leans forward curious

laugh.action: bursts into laughter, covers mouth, shoulders shake, wipes eye

think.action: tilts head, finger on chin, looks up pondering, nods slowly

nod.action: nods warmly, smiles with understanding, small thumbs up

shy.action: blushes, looks away, tucks hair behind ear, peeks back

wave.action: waves brightly at camera, leans forward, warm welcoming grin
